Determines how long Players have to take their Turn.

Turn time scales with the Cities and Units in play, the number of human Players, and the current Turn, tuned per Age. The first Turn is untimed, and the clock holds until you found a Settlement. Warning tones begin at 30 seconds; the Turn ends automatically at zero.

The kind of match. It decides where players start, and the team matches also set Start Position, Start Bias and Map Size.[n]Choosing a Match Type returns every other setting on the Game Settings, Pace, Map and Advanced tabs to its multiplayer default, with Online Game Speed and the Competitive Turn Timer. The map, the seeds, the game name, Hidden Game, Game Balance and Kick Vote stay as they are.
Players start anywhere on the map (Fresh Water, 12 tiles apart), Standard map. Every other setting returns to its default, with Online speed and the Competitive timer.
Duel placement (West vs East), Balanced starts, Multiplayer Start Bias, Tiny map built as the 36x22 Duel map. Every other setting returns to its default, with Online speed and the Competitive timer.

2v2 placement (teams 1-2-1-2 by slot: backline, then frontline), Balanced starts, Multiplayer Start Bias, Tiny map. Every other setting returns to its default, with Online speed and the Competitive timer.
3v3 placement (teams 1-2-1-2-1-2 by slot), Balanced starts, Multiplayer Start Bias, Small map. Every other setting returns to its default, with Online speed and the Competitive timer.
4v4 placement (teams 1-2-1-2-1-2-1-2 by slot), Balanced starts, Multiplayer Start Bias, Standard map. Every other setting returns to its default, with Online speed and the Competitive timer.
